description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 鼠标移到贴图上，从哪边进来，那一侧的角上就出现关闭按钮，点一下关掉贴图；下拉菜单的滚动条可以拖。权限不变。
notes.en: A round close button appears in a pin's corner on the side the mouse came in from, closing it in one click; drop-down menus get a scroll bar you can drag. Permissions unchanged.
